decisions.reason: The hierarchical search bundle has had no visible presence since 2018 and carries little commitment, but as a cheap plugin within the committed map.apps ecosystem it can still be kept for now, though withdrawal is quite possible.

VueTOC was publicly announced as a new approach, which management still feels obliged to justify, but its absence from the website since 2018 suggests it may soon be folded into other mobile offerings.
The GIS platform is the flagship product line that embodies the firm's announced direction and heavy investment, so management will persist with it regardless of short-term results.
The mobile field data capture software had a dedicated page and fits the core offer, so any weak results are still attributed to temporary adoption delays.
The search extension had its own page and is tied to the committed web map platform, so management keeps it as part of that ecosystem.
